question: According to the Competition Amendment Bill, 2022, the penalty for gun-jumping is proposed to be ____ of the deal value.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Competition Amendment Bill, 2022 proposes a penalty for gun-jumping.**
 
• Gun-jumping refers to the act of merging or acquiring a** company** before obtaining regulatory approval.
 
• The proposed penalty for gun-jumping is** 0.01% **of the deal value.
 
• **This penalty aims to discourage companies from violating competition laws and to ensure fair competition in the market.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India recently passed the Competition (Amendment) Act, 2023.**
 
• The **Competition Act, 2002**, the country's main competition law, is** **altered in a number of ways by the Act.
 
• The changes are intended to strengthen competition regulation, streamline procedures, and promote an environment that is business-friendly.
